visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with short dark hair, wearing a brown oversized t-shirt with a grey graphic, stands in a brightly lit doorway. In the foreground, an adult's hand holds a small brown teddy bear wearing a red and white Santa hat. The background is a clean indoor hallway with white walls and light wood flooring. (2) The toddler is now sitting on the wooden floor, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. The room is bathed in soft, natural indoor light. (3) The toddler crawls forward on hands and knees towards the plush bear, displaying focused facial expressions and steady movement. (4) The toddler stands up and joyfully extends both arms wide as if inviting a hug. Her mouth is slightly open in a smile. (5) In a different scene, the toddler sits in a grey cushioned baby chair wearing a white t-shirt with a Popeye graphic. She looks off-camera before noticing a bright green and yellow plush frog being presented to her. (6) Wearing a blue tank top, the toddler runs excitedly through the same hallway with arms outstretched. She grabs the green frog plush and smiles brightly. (7) The toddler sits on the floor interacting with a blue dinosaur plush toy. A second child, an older girl in a yellow bib, is visible in the background background. (8) The toddler, now in a white shirt with a lemon graphic, hugs the blue dinosaur toy tightly against her chest. (9) Sitting on the floor near adults, the toddler raises her hands and gestures outward while looking at someone off-screen. (10) An animated pink screen appears with a cartoon character of the toddler and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
